canvas_settings.image_style: clean modern high-fidelity web app UI mockup, flat design, sans-serif typography, light theme

layers.description: Solid light grey page backdrop filling the entire square canvas behind everything else.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Root background layer; the browser window floats centered on top of it.

layers.description: A desktop browser window with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, white content area, occupying most of the canvas.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered above the background; contains the browser chrome strip at its top edge and the web page content below.

layers.description: Browser chrome strip along the window top: three small grey circular window buttons at the left and a wide rounded grey address bar holding the small grey web address "localhost:3000".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Owned by the browser window, docked to its top edge, spanning the full window width; the app card sits below it.

layers.description: A centered white application card with a thin light border, rounded corners and a subtle shadow; it holds the whole todo app.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered horizontally in the browser content area below the chrome; contains the card header, create row and list container stacked top to bottom.

layers.description: Card header band with the app title "My Todos" in large dark sans-serif text aligned to the left with padding.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: First child inside the app card, directly under its top edge; title aligned to the card left padding.

layers.description: Create row with a single-line text input showing grey placeholder text "Add a new todo…", a blue filled button labeled "Add" immediately to the right of the input, and small grey helper text "Up to 500 characters" under the input.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the app card below the header; input and button share one horizontal line, helper text left-aligned under the input.

layers.description: Rounded list container with a hairline border holding exactly four todo rows stacked vertically with thin dividers, oldest at the top; exactly one of the four rows contains a text input. The string "Edit" is rendered on rows 1, 2 and 4; the string "Delete" is rendered on rows 1, 2 and 4; the string "Cancel" is rendered exactly once, in row 3's edit controls.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the app card below the create row, spanning the card inner width; owns all four todo rows in creation order; only the third row holds an input or Save and Cancel controls.

layers.description: Todo row 1 of 4, first in creation order, done and in normal mode: a checked blue box with white tick at the left, todo text "Buy milk" in faded grey crossed by a single thin horizontal strikethrough line crossing the middle of the text, and two small grey text-buttons labeled "Edit" and "Delete" aligned at the right end of the row.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: First child of the list container; checkbox left-aligned, text left-aligned after the checkbox, action buttons right-aligned; shows no input field and no other controls.

layers.description: Todo row 2 of 4, done and in normal mode: a checked blue box with white tick at the left, todo text "Pay electricity bill" in faded grey crossed by a single thin horizontal strikethrough line crossing the middle of the text, and two small grey text-buttons labeled "Edit" and "Delete" aligned at the right end of the row.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Second child of the list container directly below the first row; identical layout grid to the first row; shows no input field and no controls other than the two named text-buttons.

layers.description: Todo row 3 of 4, not-done and the only row in edit mode: its empty unchecked box with a grey border still visible at the left, the row text replaced by one inline single-line text input prefilled with the dark text "Walk the dog in the park", and at the right end of the same line a blue filled button labeled "Save" followed by a grey text-button labeled "Cancel"; this row shows no Edit and no Delete button.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Third child of the list container directly below the second row; the inline input fills the horizontal space where the row text was, buttons right-aligned on the same line as the checkbox; no other row shares these controls.

layers.description: Todo row 4 of 4, newest at the bottom, not-done and in normal mode: an empty unchecked box with a grey border at the left, todo text "Read 20 pages" in solid dark text with no strikethrough line on this row, and two small grey text-buttons labeled "Edit" and "Delete" aligned at the right end of the row; no Cancel button appears on this row.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Fourth child of the list container, last in creation order; identical layout grid to the first row; shows plain text with no input field and no controls other than the two named text-buttons.
